record.provider: ADTAQ Storage VPS — 2 TB, 30 days free (card-gated)

free_tier.stated: 2 TB HDD (SSD-cached), 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM, 6 TB/month bandwidth on 1 Gbps. $20/month, FREE for the first month. Paid ladder is $10/TB/month with RAID6 + NVMe cache, up to 4 TB at $40.

egress.terms: Includes 6 TB per month premium bandwidth at 1 Gbps. Overage is metered. Cloudflare proxying is not included.

record.tooling: Root KVM VPS: full SSH/SFTP/rsync, mountable as rclone sftp remote or with rclone mount + fuse. Host rep explicitly runs KVM + VirtFusion.
record.chaining: One trial per customer (Stripe ties card to VirtFusion provisioning. 'our provisioning solution ties Stripe directly to Virtfusion'). The flow ties each card to one provisioning record, so a second trial needs a second card and this is NOT repeatable at scale.
record.limits_note: 30-day trial then $20/mo unless cancelled. 6 TB/month egress cap. 2 TB per server; larger trial sizes explicitly refused ('we are not offering free trials for those at this time (nor do we plan to)').
record.reliability_note: Small Idaho host (Lincoln Freedom Group LLC), Boise datacentre, RAID6. New enough that the soft launch itself was the reliability test; no long-run track record. Trial VPS is deleted if not converted.

evidence.proved: '$20/MONTH FREE for 1 Month'; 'Stripe is going to ask you for your credit card … Your card WILL NOT be charged unless you keep the server past the 30 day trial'
